changelog: Add OSD countdown display and clear button. Add server-side persistence middleware. Browser compat fixes (eval to script-tag injection, padStart to pad2, flexbox gap to margins).
description: Automatically stop playback after a user-defined duration. Features preset timers (15m-2h), OSD countdown with clear button, 'Are you still watching?' popup, per-device install/uninstall, and server-side persistence across restarts.
name: Sleep Timer
